_: The phone and the car with the server out of reach (v2 §6.10-§6.11, AUDIT V10-V11). OfflineVoiceTest.kt, OnDeviceSttTest.kt and AudioFocusTest.kt read this; android-app/tools/offline_voice_test.py is the mirror.

speech._: Who says a line offline, by the worn theme pack's voice.offline.fallback. Best first. bundled-voice: the system engine is the last resort and is announced, never silent. prerendered-clips (AURA, PROMPT section 3): no other voice ever; her own voice on the phone (Kokoro af_heart, T-0872) says a line with no clip only once this phone has measured it keeping up in real time (ownVoiceRealtime); until then the line stays unsaid and her offline notice, a clip in her voice, says why once. A line with a cached clip is never re-synthesised.

listen._: Who hears the user. audioInHand: the turn's audio is already captured (the Hermes path); otherwise the microphone is not open yet (the house pipeline). The platform recogniser owns the microphone and cannot take audio, so with audio in hand only the bundled model can. A gate that is enforcing needs the server's ears: words typed on-device would walk past it.
listen.none_says: I can't hear you without the server: this phone has no speech recognition of its own to use.
listen.gate_says: I can't check your voice while the server is out, so I can't take that by voice.

server out, mic not open, nothing on the phone says so
server out, the speaker gate enforcing, says so rather than bypass it

focus._: The turn's microphone and reply hold audio focus that ducks the music and ends on a call. TurnFocus (AudioAttention.kt).
